functions.name: PerformAnalysis
functions.summary: Configures first-order elastic analysis instructions.
functions.detail: Unlike Root.AnalyzeEx, this adds model commands and never runs the solver. Native void completion supplies no success flag.

functions.name: PerformPDeltaAnalysisNoConverge
functions.summary: Configures the documented small-delta P-Delta command.
functions.detail: Use PerformPDeltaAnalysisEx to select large versus small delta or geometric stiffness. The deprecated Converge entry is not used. Native void gives no acknowledgement.

functions.name: PerformPDeltaAnalysisEx
functions.parameters: int numberOfIterations, PrintOption printOption, PDeltaDisplacementEffect displacementEffect, bool includeGeometricStiffness
functions.summary: Configures P-Delta instructions with an explicit displacement formulation.
functions.detail: SmallDelta is native 1 and LargeDelta 0; geometric stiffness is a separate Int16 0/1 flag. Unlike the NoConverge shortcut, both choices are explicit. Native void gives no acknowledgement.

functions.name: PerformPDeltaAnalysis
functions.summary: Configures P-Delta instructions from the main-project typed options.
functions.detail: This convenience delegates once to PerformPDeltaAnalysisEx and reports that exact native function. It does not call both P-Delta variants or execute analysis. Native void gives no acknowledgement.

functions.name: PerformCableAnalysis
functions.summary: Configures the legacy cable-analysis instruction.
functions.detail: Requires cable members and a compatible license/context. Native may select its licensed algorithm. Use PerformCableAnalysisEx for explicit algorithm and parameter packets. PrintModeShapes=4 is unavailable here. Native void gives no acknowledgement.

functions.name: PerformCableAnalysisEx
functions.summary: Configures basic or advanced cable analysis using typed settings.
functions.detail: Basic sends seven Double parameters and null advanced flags; Advanced sends three Double parameters and two Int16 flags. Source defaults and validation are retained. PrintModeShapes=4 is unavailable. Native 1/true acknowledges configuration, 0/false reports failure; neither proves license availability or convergence.

functions.name: PerformBucklingAnalysis
functions.summary: Configures legacy buckling-analysis instructions.
functions.detail: Use PerformBucklingAnalysisEx to choose Iterative or Eigen explicitly and obtain a native acknowledgement. PrintModeShapes=4 is unavailable here. Native void gives no acknowledgement.

functions.name: PerformBucklingAnalysisEx
functions.parameters: BucklingAnalysisMethod method, int maximumSteps, PrintOption printOption
functions.summary: Configures buckling analysis with an explicit solver method.
functions.detail: Iterative=0 and Eigen=1 are native selectors. maximumSteps applies to the basic solver as documented; it is not a promised iteration count for every engine. PrintModeShapes=4 is reserved. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: PerformDirectAnalysis
functions.summary: Configures AISC Direct Analysis instructions.
functions.detail: Uses LRFD=1 or ASD=2, four Double parameters and two Int16 flags in the documented order. P-Delta iterations above 15 are rejected rather than silently reset. Translation/rotation displacement tolerance retains the native mixed convention; no unit conversion occurs. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: PerformNonlinearAnalysisEx
functions.summary: Configures nonlinear-analysis and optional displacement-control instructions.
functions.detail: ArcLength zero disables displacement control. Null target sends native null; an explicit target sends joint ID, global DOF and signed target value as three Doubles. Rebuild and geometric stiffness remain independent selectors. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails. No result or convergence is inferred.

functions.name: SetFloorDiaphragmBaseCommand
functions.summary: Adds or updates the floor-diaphragm base instruction.
functions.detail: Elevation is a finite signed value in current native length units, not a node ID or floor number. Does not create diaphragm geometry. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: DeleteFloorDiaphragmBaseCommand
functions.summary: Deletes the floor-diaphragm base instruction.
functions.detail: This removes command configuration, not diaphragm entities or an analysis result. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails; false is not interpreted as proven absence.

functions.name: SetCheckSoftStoryCommand
functions.summary: Adds or updates the soft-story checking instruction.
functions.detail: Native codes are IS1893:2002=1, ASCE7:2005/2010/2016=2, IS1893:2016=3. This selector differs from the irregularities selector, whose value 1 is unavailable. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: DeleteCheckSoftStoryCommand
functions.summary: Deletes the soft-story checking instruction.
functions.detail: Does not run a structural-code check or delete model stories. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: SetCheckIrregularitiesCommand
functions.summary: Adds or updates the irregularities checking instruction.
functions.detail: Requires floor-diaphragm data in the native model. ASCE7:2016=2 and IS1893:2016=3; value 1 is not supported by this contract. No applicability or code-compliance conclusion is produced. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: DeleteCheckIrregularitiesCommand
functions.summary: Deletes the irregularities checking instruction.
functions.detail: Does not delete floor diaphragms or clear existing engineering results. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails.

functions.name: DeleteAllAnalysisCommands
functions.summary: Deletes the native perform-analysis command inventory.
functions.detail: Native 1/true acknowledges deletion. Native 0/false specifically means no perform-analysis commands were present and returns NoCommandsPresent, not a generic failure. Other model instructions and files are not asserted to be cleared.

functions.name: CreateElasticMat
functions.parameters: FoundationSupportDirection direction, double subgradeModulus, bool printInfluenceAreas = false, FoundationSpringType springType = FoundationSpringType.None
functions.summary: Creates an elastic-mat support definition without assigning it.
functions.detail: Uses one scalar Double subgrade in force/length cubed, direction 0..5 and separate Long print/spring flags. This differs from plate-mat scalar/array creation, which remains gated. A positive return is a support definition ID; zero is native failure, unlike fixed-support creation whose failure is -1.

functions.name: CreateElasticFooting
functions.parameters: double length, double width, FoundationSupportDirection direction, double subgradeModulus
functions.summary: Creates an elastic-footing definition without assigning it.
functions.detail: Length and width must be finite and positive in current native length units. Subgrade is finite and nonnegative in force/length cubed, not a nodal spring stiffness. Direction 0..5 preserves X/Y/Z versus XOnly/YOnly/ZOnly. Positive return is a definition ID; zero is native failure.

functions.name: RemoveElasticMat
functions.summary: Removes an elastic-mat definition by its support reference ID.
functions.detail: This definition-level call differs from RemoveElasticMatFromNode. Shared-assignment consequences are left to STAAD and are not enumerated or certified. Actual Boolean or integral 1/0 acknowledgements are supported; undocumented negative values are rejected.

functions.name: RemoveElasticMatFromNode
functions.summary: Removes the elastic-mat assignment from one analytical node.
functions.detail: The argument is a node ID, not a support definition ID. No shared-definition deletion is inferred. TRUE/FALSE is decoded independently of the zero-success legacy AssignSupportToNodes route. Actual Boolean or integral 1/0 acknowledgements are supported; undocumented negative values are rejected.

functions.name: RemovePlateMat
functions.summary: Removes a plate-mat definition by its support reference ID.
functions.detail: Accepts an existing definition ID even though plate-mat creation/readback remain gated. This is not the unresolved two-argument RemovePlateMatFromPlate operation. Shared-assignment consequences are left to STAAD. Actual Boolean or integral 1/0 values implement the documented TRUE/FALSE return; negative values are rejected.

functions.name: RemoveElasticFooting
functions.summary: Removes an elastic-footing definition by its support reference ID.
functions.detail: This definition-level operation differs from node-specific removal. Its documented numeric 1/0 convention is decoded narrowly; integral -1 is rejected, not treated as true. No assignment enumeration, effect verification or automatic deletion of other foundations is promised.

functions.name: RemoveElasticFootingFromNode
functions.summary: Removes the elastic-footing assignment from one analytical node.
functions.detail: The argument is an analytical node ID, not a support definition ID. Native 1/true acknowledges and 0/false fails. Integral -1 is not a success flag for this operation. Shared definition deletion is not inferred.

functions.name: AssignSupportToEntities
functions.parameters: int supportId, SupportEntityKind entityKind, IEnumerable<int> entityIds, int maximumResults = 100000
functions.summary: Assigns a support through the native entity-list route with an explicit requested entity family.
functions.detail: Calls AssignSupportToEntityList(supportId, Int32[]), preserving order/duplicates in an owned packet. Plates are required for plate-mat definitions; nodes for other types. entityKind records caller intent and is not a native selector or proof of the definition type. The caller must choose the matching family. Unlike AssignSupportToNodes, native TRUE/FALSE uses actual Boolean or integral 1/0 rather than integral zero-success. Empty input is NoOperation without native invocation. Receipts preserve EntityIds/EntityKind; NodeIds is empty for plates.
